### Review boundaries

- [ ] I separated what the source **observes** from my **interpretation** through the model.
- [ ] I used the minimum stage and Selection-condition mapping supported by the source.
- [ ] I did not infer unreported scale, causality, or organizational adoption.
- [ ] I stated what the evidence does **not** establish.
- [ ] The contribution contains exactly one primary model implication.
- [ ] I am not treating acceptance into the evidence base as proof of the model.
